label: Operating without GSTIN while selling to registered businesses
best_case: A customer asks for a GST invoice. You explain you're below the threshold; they shrug and pay anyway.
worst_case: Procurement at your best lead refuses to onboard an unregistered vendor. The deal stalls until you have a GSTIN, which takes weeks you don't have.

sources.title: CGST Act s.22 and common procurement practice

label: Not expecting TDS on the first invoice
best_case: The customer pays 10% short. Their accountant explains 194J and sends you the Form 16A later.
worst_case: The payment lands 10% short with no explanation. You spend two days chasing 'the missing money' and annoy the one champion you had.

label: Working with a customer without a signed scope or terms
best_case: The customer asks for one extra feature 'as discussed'. You do it in a day.
worst_case: The customer disputes what was promised, refuses to pay the balance, and there is nothing in writing but a WhatsApp thread.

label: Belief that a payment gateway requires an incorporated company
best_case: You look it up properly, or a friend tells you a PAN and a bank account are enough. You lose an afternoon.
worst_case: You park payments 'until we incorporate'. Weeks pass. Nobody pays because there is no way to pay.

sources.title: Payment gateway onboarding docs for individuals

label: INC-20A not filed within 180 days of incorporation
best_case: Your CA reminds you in month five and files it for a small fee.
worst_case: Day 181. Penalty on the company and each director, and the bank freezes the loan conversation you had started.

label: First auditor not appointed within 30 days of incorporation
best_case: The CA who incorporated you quietly files ADT-1 and adds it to the bill.
worst_case: Nobody filed ADT-1. You discover it at year-end when the audit is due and the ROC filing is already late.

label: Name spelled differently across PAN, Aadhaar and bank
best_case: The bank clerk notices, sighs, and accepts an affidavit.
worst_case: The current account application bounces. Then the payment gateway KYC bounces for the same reason. A week gone per bounce.

sources.title: Common founder complaints on forums and X about KYC rejections

label: Cofounder equity agreed verbally, no vesting, nothing signed
best_case: Nothing happens for months. It comes up only when someone asks for a cap table.
worst_case: Your friend stops showing up but still 'owns 40%'. Fixing it costs the friendship or the equity.

label: Building on the side while an employment contract assigns IP to the employer
best_case: Nobody at work notices or cares.
worst_case: A colleague mentions your side project to your manager. HR asks for a meeting. You now need a lawyer, or a resignation date.

label: GST returns not filed for a nil month
best_case: Late fee of a few hundred rupees and a nag from the CA.
worst_case: Three months unfiled. Late fees have compounded and the portal now blocks your e-way bills and your customer's ITC shows as pending; they call you.

sources.title: CGST Act s.47 late fee; GSTR-1/3B filing rules

label: Agency-built product has an unexamined performance problem
best_case: A user mentions the dashboard is slow. The agency fixes an N+1 query in a day.
worst_case: Signups fall off after the first screen. The agency says it's fine on their machine. You cannot tell who is right.
note: Invented scenario for the hidden-factor mechanic.
